title: Fix OpenAI streaming tool call accumulation across chunks
description: P1 — OpenAICompatibleChatProvider.ReadOpenAIStreamToolCalls only captures single-delta-chunk tool calls. Standard OpenAI SSE sends tool call arguments incrementally across multiple chunks (index, id, type, function.name, function.arguments across separate SSE events). Incremental arguments are silently lost — the LLM "thinks" it called a tool but arguments are truncated. Fix: implement accumulator state dictionary keyed by tool_call_index to accumulate incremental arguments across stream iterations. Found in 10-agent codebase audit 2026-07-10 (P1-013).
